ValidationRule.description: Operations team can enter Profit Center, Effective Start Date and Company Code when creating a Catalog, but not change them afterwards.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.RES_Config_Switch__c.RES_Validation_Rules_Off__c), NOT(ISNEW()), $Permission.RES_Product_Operation_Visibility, OR( ISCHANGED(RES_Profit_Center__c), ISCHANGED(EffectiveStartDate), ISCHANGED(RES_Company_Code__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Profit Center, Effective Start Date and Company Code cannot be changed after the Catalog is created.
